entries.title: Matthew 27:1
segments: And [it] becoming early morning, all the chief priests and elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put Him to death.

entries.title: Matthew 27:2
segments: And when they had bound Him, they led [Him] away and delivered Him to Pontius Pilate the governor.

entries.title: Matthew 27:3
segments: Then he who had betrayed Him, seeing that He was condemned, sorrowing, Judas returned the thirty pieces of silver again to the chief priests and elders,

entries.title: Matthew 27:4
segments: saying, I have sinned, betraying innocent blood. And they said, What [is that] to us? You see [to that].

entries.title: Matthew 27:5
segments: And he threw the pieces of silver down in the temple and departed. And he went and hanged himself.

entries.title: Matthew 27:6
segments: And the chief priests took the silver pieces, and said, It is not lawful to put them into the treasury, because it is [the] price of blood.

entries.title: Matthew 27:7
segments: And they took counsel and bought the potter's field with them, to bury strangers in.

entries.title: Matthew 27:8
segments: Therefore that field was called, The Field of Blood, to this day.

entries.title: Matthew 27:9
segments: Then that which was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled, saying, "And they took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of Him who had been priced, whom they of the children of Israel valued,

entries.title: Matthew 27:10
segments: and gave them for the potter's field, as the Lord appointed me."

entries.title: Matthew 27:11
segments: And Jesus stood before the governor. And the governor asked Him, saying, Are you the king of the Jews? And Jesus said to him, You say [it].

entries.title: Matthew 27:12
segments: And when He was accused by the chief priests and elders, He answered nothing.

entries.title: Matthew 27:13
segments: Then Pilate said to Him, Do you not hear how many things they witness against you?

entries.title: Matthew 27:14
segments: And He did not answer him a word, so that the governor greatly marveled.

entries.title: Matthew 27:15
segments: Now at [that] feast the governor was accustomed to release to the people a prisoner, whomever they desired.

entries.title: Matthew 27:16
segments: And they then had a notorious prisoner called Barabbas.

entries.title: Matthew 27:17
segments: Therefore when they were gathered together, Pilate said to them, Whom do you desire that I release to you? Barabbas, or Jesus [who is] called Christ?

entries.title: Matthew 27:18
segments: For he knew they had delivered Him because of envy.

entries.title: Matthew 27:19
segments: But as he was sitting down on the judgment seat, his wife sent to him, saying, Have nothing to do with that just man, for today because of Him I have suffered many things in a dream.

entries.title: Matthew 27:20
segments: But the chief priests and elders persuaded the crowd that they should ask [for] Barabbas and destroy Jesus.

entries.title: Matthew 27:21
segments: The governor answered and said to them, Which of the two do you desire that I release [to] you? They said, Barabbas.

entries.title: Matthew 27:22
segments: Pilate said to them, What then shall I do with Jesus, who is called Christ? [They] all said to him, Let Him be crucified.

entries.title: Matthew 27:23
segments: And the governor said, Why? What evil has He done? But they cried out the more, saying, let Him be crucified!

entries.title: Matthew 27:24
segments: But when Pilate saw that it gained nothing, but rather [that] a tumult was made, he took water and washed [his] hands before the crowd, saying, I am innocent of the blood of this just person. You see to it.

entries.title: Matthew 27:25
segments: Then all the people answered and said, Let His blood [be] on us and on our children.

entries.title: Matthew 27:26
segments: Then he released Barabbas to them. And when he had scourged Jesus, he delivered [Him] to be crucified.

entries.title: Matthew 27:27
segments: Then taking Jesus into the praetorium, the soldiers of the governor gathered the cohort against Him.

entries.title: Matthew 27:28
segments: And stripping Him, they put a scarlet robe around Him.

entries.title: Matthew 27:29
segments: And plaiting a crown of thorns, they put [it] on His head, and a reed in His right hand. And they bowed the knee before Him and mocked Him, saying, Hail, King of the Jews!

entries.title: Matthew 27:30
segments: And spitting at Him, [they] took the reed and struck at His head.

entries.title: Matthew 27:31
segments: And after they had mocked Him, they took the robe off of Him and put His own clothing on Him and led Him away to crucify [Him].

entries.title: Matthew 27:32
segments: And going out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name. They forced this one to carry His cross.

entries.title: Matthew 27:33
segments: And coming to a place called Golgotha, which is called, Place of a Skull,

entries.title: Matthew 27:34
segments: they gave Him vinegar mixed with gall to drink. And when He had tasted, He would not drink.

entries.title: Matthew 27:35
segments: And they crucified Him, dividing His garments, casting a lot; so that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, "They parted My garments among them, and they cast a lot for My clothing."

entries.title: Matthew 27:36
segments: And sitting down they guarded Him there.

entries.title: Matthew 27:37
segments: And they put up over His head His accusation, written, THIS IS JESUS THE KING OF THE JEWS.

entries.title: Matthew 27:38
segments: Then two thieves were crucified with Him, one off [the] right, one off [the] left.

entries.title: Matthew 27:39
segments: And those who passed by blasphemed Him, shaking their heads,

entries.title: Matthew 27:40
segments: and saying, [You] destroying the temple and building [it] in three days, save yourself. If you are the Son of God, come down from the cross.

entries.title: Matthew 27:41
segments: And in the same way also the chief priests mocked, with the scribes and elders, saying,

entries.title: Matthew 27:42
segments: He saved others, but he cannot save himself. If he is the King of Israel, let him now come down from the cross, and we will believe him.

entries.title: Matthew 27:43
segments: He trusted in God, let Him deliver him now, if He will have him. (For He said, I am [the] Son of God.)

entries.title: Matthew 27:44
segments: And also the thieves who were crucified with Him reviled Him, [saying] the same.

entries.title: Matthew 27:45
segments: And from [the] sixth hour there was darkness over all the land until [the] ninth hour.

entries.title: Matthew 27:46
segments: And about the ninth hour, Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani? That is, My God, My God, why have You forsaken me?

entries.title: Matthew 27:47
segments: Some of those who stood there, when they heard, said, This one calls for Elijah.

entries.title: Matthew 27:48
segments: And immediately one of them ran and took a sponge and filled it with vinegar, and he put [it] on a reed and gave it to Him to drink.

entries.title: Matthew 27:49
segments: The rest said, Let Him alone, let us see whether Elijah will come to save Him.

entries.title: Matthew 27:50
segments: And crying again with a loud voice, Jesus released [His] spirit.

entries.title: Matthew 27:51
segments: And, behold! The veil of the temple was torn in two from top to bottom. And the earth quaked, and the rocks were sheared,

entries.title: Matthew 27:52
segments: and the tombs were opened, and many bodies of the saints who had fallen asleep arose,

entries.title: Matthew 27:53
segments: and coming out of the tomb after His resurrection [they] went into the holy city and appeared to many.

entries.title: Matthew 27:54
segments: But the centurion and those guarding Jesus, seeing the earthquake, and the things that took place, [they] feared greatly, saying, Truly this One was Son of God.

entries.title: Matthew 27:55
segments: And many of the women were there, watching from a distance, [those] who had followed Jesus from Galilee, ministering to Him, watching from a distance;

entries.title: Matthew 27:56
segments: among whom was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of Zebedee's children.

entries.title: Matthew 27:57
segments: When the evening had come, a rich man of Arimathea, named Joseph, came, who also himself was Jesus' disciple.

entries.title: Matthew 27:58
segments: He went to Pilate and begged the body of Jesus. Then Pilate commanded the body to be delivered.

entries.title: Matthew 27:59
segments: When Joseph had taken the body, he wrapped it in clean linen,

entries.title: Matthew 27:60
segments: and laid it in his new tomb, which he had cut out of the rock. And he rolled a great stone to the door of the tomb and departed.

entries.title: Matthew 27:61
segments: And Mary Magdalene, and the other Mary, were sitting there across from the tomb.

entries.title: Matthew 27:62
segments: And on the next day, which was after the Preparation, the chief priests and the Pharisees gathered to Pilate,

entries.title: Matthew 27:63
segments: saying, Sir, we remember that that deceiver said, while He was living, After three days I will rise again.

entries.title: Matthew 27:64
segments: Then command that the tomb be made secure until the third day, lest his disciples come by night and steal him away and say to the people, He has risen from the dead. So the last error will be worse than the first.

entries.title: Matthew 27:65
segments: Pilate said to them, You have a watch. Go and make [it] as secure as you can.

entries.title: Matthew 27:66
segments: And going they made the tomb secure, sealing the stone along with the guard.
